items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: I played behind Little Richard there. Escarito. Oh, we played behind quite a few.

ctx.x: Yeah, and she didn't say that. That's what it was. But she was a perfect lady. She didn't drink, didn't smoke. She was strictly in the business to get to money. How would she say? She said, it's business with me, and that's the way I treat her. But I played behind her there. I can remember playing behind, what is his name? If you want to play a card, baby. Girl, don't you know you got to deal some time. Billy Wright? Billy Wright. Billy Wright. I played behind Billy Wright there. I played behind Little Richard…
So at that point, would you say you had the house band? Yeah, the house band and the Dewdrop.
